Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# try a few plausible AMQP message encodings with malformed list lengths
cands=[]
# described list32 with descriptor 0x70 and length/count combos
for payload in [
    bytes([0x00,0x53,0x70, 0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01, 0x45]),
    bytes([0x00,0x53,0x70, 0x00,0x00,0x00,0x02, 0x45,0x00]),
    bytes([0x00,0x53,0x70, 0x00,0x00,0x00,0x04, 0x45,0x00,0x00,0x00]),
    bytes([0x00,0x53,0x70, 0x00,0x00,0x00,0x08, 0x45,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00]),
]:
    cands.append(payload)
for i,b in enumerate(cands):
    p=Path(f'/workspace/c{i}.bin'); p.write_bytes(b)
    print(p, len(b))
PY
for f in /workspace/c0.bin /workspace/c1.bin /workspace/c2.bin /workspace/c3.bin; do bash /workspace/submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true; done
